description: Manipulate archive files with the BSD tar implementation from libarchive.

option.name: --absolute-paths
tip: preserve absolute pathnames

option.name: --acls
tip: (create/extract) archive or extract POSIX.1e or NFSv4 ACLs

option.name: --auto-compress
tip: (create) choose the archive format and compression from the file suffix

option.name: --b64encode
tip: (create) base64-encode the archive after compression

option.name: --block-size
tip: set the block size in 512-byte records for tape I/O

option.name: --bunzip2
tip: (create) compress the archive with bzip2

option.name: --check-links
tip: (create/append) warn unless all links to each file are archived

option.name: --chroot
tip: (extract) chroot to the current directory after processing -C options and before extracting

option.name: --clamp-mtime
tip: only set the modification time if the file is newer than the --mtime date

option.name: --clear-nochange-fflags
tip: (extract) clear platform-specific file flags before replacing an object

option.name: --confirmation
tip: ask for confirmation for every action

option.name: --dereference
tip: (create/append) follow all symbolic links

option.name: --directory
tip: change to the directory before processing the following files, or before extracting

option.name: --exclude
tip: do not process files or directories matching the pattern

option.name: --exclude-from
tip: read exclusion patterns from the given file

option.name: --exclude-vcs
tip: do not process files and directories used by version control systems

option.name: --fast-read
tip: (extract/list) stop after the first matching entry for each pattern

option.name: --fflags
tip: (create/extract) archive or extract platform-specific file flags

option.name: --file
tip: read or write the archive file; - means standard input or output

option.name: --files-from
tip: read names to include or extract from the given file

option.name: --format
tip: create an archive of the given format
supported formats: cpio, pax, shar, ustar
other libarchive formats may also be supported

next.name: cpio
tip: cpio format

next.name: pax
tip: POSIX pax format

next.name: shar
tip: shell archive

next.name: ustar
tip: POSIX ustar format

option.name: --gid
tip: use the given numeric group id

option.name: --gname
tip: use the given group name

option.name: --group
tip: use the given group name or numeric id, optionally as name:gid

option.name: --grzip
tip: (create) compress the archive with grzip

option.name: --gunzip
tip: (create) compress the archive with gzip

option.name: --help
tip: show usage

option.name: --hfsCompression
tip: (extract, macOS) compress extracted regular files with HFS+ compression

option.name: --ignore-zeros
tip: ignore zeroed blocks in the archive; a GNU tar compatibility alias

option.name: --include
tip: process only files or directories matching the pattern

option.name: --keep-newer-files
tip: (extract) do not overwrite existing files newer than the archive copy

option.name: --keep-old-files
tip: (extract) do not overwrite existing files

option.name: --lrzip
tip: (create) compress the archive with lrzip

option.name: --lz4
tip: (create) compress the archive with lz4

option.name: --lzip
tip: (create) compress the archive with lzip

option.name: --lzma
tip: (create) compress the archive with LZMA

option.name: --lzop
tip: (create) compress the archive with lzop

option.name: --mac-metadata
tip: (create/extract, macOS) archive or extract ACLs and extended attributes in AppleDouble format

option.name: --mode
tip: modify file mode bits when creating or extracting

option.name: --modification-time
tip: (extract) do not restore modification times

option.name: --mtime
tip: (create/append/update) set the modification time of added files

option.name: --newer
tip: (create/append/update) include only files newer than the date, comparing ctime

option.name: --newer-mtime
tip: (create/append/update) like --newer, but compare mtime

option.name: --newer-mtime-than
tip: (create/append/update) like --newer-than, but compare mtime

option.name: --newer-than
tip: (create/append/update) include only files newer than the given file, comparing ctime

option.name: --no-acls
tip: (create/extract) do not archive or extract POSIX ACLs

option.name: --no-fflags
tip: (create/extract) do not archive or extract file flags

option.name: --no-mac-metadata
tip: (create/extract, macOS) do not archive or extract AppleDouble metadata

option.name: --no-read-sparse
tip: (create/append/update) do not read sparse file information

option.name: --no-recursion
tip: do not recurse into directories

option.name: --no-safe-writes
tip: (extract) replace files in place instead of using temporary files

option.name: --no-same-owner
tip: (extract) do not restore owner and group IDs

option.name: --no-same-permissions
tip: (extract) do not restore full permissions

option.name: --no-xattrs
tip: (create/extract) do not archive or extract extended attributes

option.name: --nodump
tip: (create/append) skip files with the nodump flag

option.name: --nopreserveHFSCompression
tip: (extract, macOS) do not compress extracted files with HFS+ compression

option.name: --null
tip: read names or patterns separated by NUL instead of newlines

option.name: --numeric-owner
tip: use numeric user and group IDs instead of names

option.name: --older
tip: (create/append/update) include only files older than the date, comparing ctime

option.name: --older-mtime
tip: like --older, but compare mtime

option.name: --older-mtime-than
tip: like --older-than, but compare mtime

option.name: --older-than
tip: include only files older than the given file, comparing ctime

option.name: --one-file-system
tip: (create/append/update) do not cross mount points

option.name: --options
tip: set module-specific options as a comma-separated list
forms: key=value, key, !key, module:key=value
example: gzip:compression-level=9

option.name: --owner
tip: use the given user name or numeric id, optionally as name:uid

option.name: --passphrase
tip: passphrase for an encrypted archive
currently only zip encryption is supported

option.name: --posix
tip: synonym for --format pax

option.name: --preserve-permissions
tip: (extract) restore full permissions, including ACLs and flags

option.name: --read-full-blocks
tip: ignored; accepted for compatibility with other tar implementations

option.name: --read-sparse
tip: (create/append/update) read sparse file information

option.name: --safe-writes
tip: (extract) write to a temporary file and rename it into place

option.name: --same-owner
tip: (extract) restore owner and group IDs

option.name: --strip-components
tip: remove the given number of leading path elements

option.name: --to-stdout
tip: (extract/list) write file contents to standard output

option.name: --totals
tip: (create/append/update) print a summary to stderr

option.name: --uid
tip: use the given numeric user id

option.name: --uname
tip: use the given user name

option.name: --uncompress
tip: (create) compress the archive with compress

option.name: --unlink-first
tip: (extract) unlink files before creating them

option.name: --use-compress-program
tip: pipe the archive through the given program

option.name: --uuencode
tip: (create) uuencode the archive after compression

option.name: --verbose
tip: list processed files verbosely

option.name: --version
tip: print the version of bsdtar and libarchive

option.name: --xattrs
tip: (create/extract) archive or extract extended attributes

option.name: --xz
tip: (create) compress the archive with xz

option.name: --zstd
tip: (create) compress the archive with zstd

option.name: -H
tip: (create/append) follow symbolic links named on the command line

option.name: -o
tip: (extract) use the invoking user's user and group
(create/append/update) synonym for --format ustar

option.name: -s
tip: modify file or archive member names with a sed-style substitution pattern

option.name: -S
tip: (extract) write sparse files as sparse
